## Purpose
Imports a transformation-recommendation file. Each recommendation becomes a process document filed on its L3 node (created under the chosen domain when missing). A preview first shows, per recommendation, the attributes a build needs to choose an agent type that the file does not give.

## Responsibilities
- `recommendationsApi.import({file | content, domain_id, save})` (from `api/knowledge.ts`), first with `save=false` to preview, then with `save=true` to commit. `ReportView` and `RecommendationRow`.
